info.title: Festapp integrations API
info.description: Delegated personal OAuth, code + PKCE S256, explicit resource and consent. Not an autonomous organization identity. Read-only POSTs may be repeated; keyset pages are not a snapshot. Decimal money remains a string. Never generate a new commandId after a timeout. Refresh once per connection; atomically persist the rotated token. Reuse, lost refresh responses and grant expiry require reconnect. API consent is currently limited to 7 days pending refresh-store capacity qualification; legacy MCP 30/90/365-day choices remain on their original boundary. A 30-day idle limit never extends consent. Access tokens live at most 300 seconds. OAuth 2.1 and Idempotency-Key are drafts; no FAPI compliance claim. API data uses no-store. Runtime cross-field refinements remain mandatory.

x-client-proof-policy: A registered DPoP-only client must also supply a bound DPoP token and fresh DPoP proof. OAuth alone is never sufficient for that client.

post.description:
Read the canonical event report for one explicitly selected occasion: distinct valid ticket counts, waiting tickets, order/ticket states and amounts by currency. Resolve ambiguous event names with the user first; never read or combine multiple matching events unless explicitly requested. An order may contain multiple people. Cancelled and waitlisted tickets are excluded from valid totals.

Read may be repeated. Keyset pages are not a snapshot.

post.description:
List a bounded page of orders for one selected occasion, at most 50. Search only by the exact 10-character order symbol. Returns order identifiers, stored state, ticket count and amounts. No buyer names, email addresses, registration answers, notes, QR codes or personal ticket content.

Read may be repeated. Keyset pages are not a snapshot.
